survival.frontierhunts.journal.exempt: Creative and spectator players are exempt: the meters and body heat are paused.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.fed.desc: Keep protein, fat and energy up and eat wild game for Hunter's Vigor.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.chil: Chilly. Furs, a roof or a fire will stop the slide.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.comf: Comfortable. Wet clothes, wind and nightfall all cut your warmth.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.free: You are freezing and losing health. Get to a fire or shelter now.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.heat: Heat stroke: you move slower. Get out of the sun and cool down.
Too warm: sweating costs energy. Find shade or shed a layer.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.hypo: Hypothermia: slow and clumsy, healing halved. Find heat before it gets worse.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.shiv: Shivering: your aim shakes and you move slower. Warm up by a fire, out of the wind.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.hungry.de: Running low. Wild game restores protein and fat fastest; fat trimmings, tallow and pemmican refill fat.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.lean.off: Lean seasons are off on this server: game is in the same condition all year.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.mode.0.de: Survival is off on this server: vanilla hunger only. Your survival record below is kept.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.mode.1.de: Meters drain slowly and an empty meter only slows you down. The cold never hurts you.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.mode.2.de: Wild game keeps you strong; farm food and crops are worth a little less. Starving and freezing hurt.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.mode.3.de: Fast drain, farm food at half value, no natural healing without protein. Hunger and cold can kill.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.perk.prov: Wild game gives %s more protein, fat and energy, plus extra hunger.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.perk.thic: Your body loses heat %s slower in the cold, and freezing builds slower.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.perk.trai: Walking and working outdoors drains %s less hunger and nutrition.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.temperatu: Body temperature is off on this server.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.vigor.des: Well fed on wild game: +2 hearts, faster healing and a lighter step.
